findings.title: Unimplemented Phase 5 logic in research commands

evidence.observation: Multiple Phase 5 TODO comments found indicating incomplete authorization checking and memory integration logic.

proposed_action.description: Implement Supabase authorization checks and decision_to_memory integration marked as Phase 5 TODOs.

findings.expected_benefit: Completes core authorization and state persistence paths, avoiding incomplete runtime behaviors.

findings.title: Unimplemented quality anomalies query in quality forecasting

evidence.observation: TODO comment indicates recent_anomalies is hardcoded as empty list instead of querying quality_anomalies table.

proposed_action.description: Implement actual query against quality_anomalies table to populate recent_anomalies.

findings.expected_benefit: Restores accurate quality forecasting by utilizing real anomalous quality records.

findings.title: Missing model router call log file

evidence.observation: Router status indicates call_log_exists is false for configured log path /opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl.

proposed_action.description: Ensure the directory exists and permissions are configured so model router request logs are written.

findings.expected_benefit: Enables traceability, latency tracking, and failure auditing for model routing operations.

findings.title: Direct API calls bypassing central model router in emergency alert processing

evidence.observation: Direct calls to call_gemini and call_mistral using raw API keys instead of dispatching through the model router.

proposed_action.description: Route emergency alert LLM requests through the centralized model router endpoint.

findings.expected_benefit: Provides centralized telemetry, fallback routing, and unified key management.
